latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of cm-discord-bot-builder.

- Scaffold, deploy, and maintain Discord bots using discord.py, discord.js, or Serenity (Rust).
- Generates project skeletons for each library and registers slash commands, message components, modals, autocomplete, threads, and voice features.
- Provides guidance on gateway intents, persistent state (sqlite/postgres/redis), rate limit handling, hosting options, observability, testing, and bot security.
- Suitable for building new bots, adding commands, creating feature bots (ticket, reaction roles, mod log, leveling, music, captcha), or migrating bots between libraries.
- Triggers on common Discord bot development topics and keywords.
